crossRefs.note: Then he said to me, “Have you seen this, son of man? Is it a light thing to the house of Judah that they commit the…
The man said to me, “Son of man, see with your eyes, and hear with your ears, and set your heart on all that I will…
Yahweh said to me, “Son of man, mark well, and see with your eyes, and hear with your ears all that I tell you…
Moreover Yahweh’s word came to me, saying, “Jeremiah, what do you see?” I said, “I see a branch of an almond tree.”
He said to me, “What do you see?” I said, “I have seen, and behold, a lamp stand all of gold, with its bowl on the top…
He said to me, “What do you see?” I answered, “I see a flying scroll; its length is twenty cubits, and its width ten…
Jesus said to them, “Have you understood all these things?” They answered him, “Yes, Lord.”

translations.web: He said to me, “Son of man, have you seen?” Then he brought me, and caused me to return to the bank of the river.
translations.bsb: “Son of man, do you see this?” he asked. Then he led me back to the bank of the river.
translations.kjv: And he said unto me, Son of man, hast thou seen this? Then he brought me, and caused me to return to the brink of the river.
translations.asv: And he said unto me, Son of man, hast thou seen this? Then he brought me, and caused me to return to the bank of the river.
